attachment_excerpt: Dear Sirs, Sub: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 The Company has received an order dated October 6, 2026 (“Order”) passed by the Joint Commissioner of Customs (Import), ACC, Mumbai levying on the Company a redemption fine and penalty aggregating Rs. 18,74,978 under applicable provisions of the Customs Act, 1962. The Order has been passed alleging that the Company discharged a lesser custom duty by incorrect classification of imported goods in the Bill of Entry. The Company intends to file an appeal against the Order. The financial impact of the Order is to the extent of the redemption fine and penalty levied. There is no impact on operations or other activities of the Company due to the Order. The Order was received by the Company today, by email, at 12:21 p.m. (IST). This is for information and record.
